from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs/task-8adccec3.py')
code='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    def mode(values):
        return Counter(values).most_common(1)[0][0]

    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if mode(grid[r]) != background]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if mode([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) != background]
    if len(row_lines) < 2 or len(col_lines) < 2:
        return [[background]]

    line_colors = {mode(grid[r]) for r in row_lines}
    line_colors.update(mode([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) for c in col_lines)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(row_lines, row_lines[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(col_lines, col_lines[1:]):
            a, b = grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1]
            c, d = grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1]
            if a == b == c == d and a != background and a not in line_colors:
                row.append(a)
            else:
                row.append(background)
        out.append(row)

    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(out) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != background]
    if not points:
        return [[background]]
    rmin = min(r for r, _ in points)
    rmax = max(r for r, _ in points)
    cmin = min(c for _, c in points)
    cmax = max(c for _, c in points)
    return [row[cmin:cmax + 1] for row in out[rmin:rmax + 1]]
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p)

import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('solver',p); solver=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(solver)

def patterned(h,w,rowlines,collines,bg,line,marks):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in rowlines:
        for c in range(w): g[r][c]=line
    for c in collines:
        for r in range(h): g[r][c]=line
    for (r,c),v in marks.items(): g[r][c]=v
    return g
# Demo 1
D1=[[1]*14 for _ in range(28)]
for r in range(28): D1[r][0]=D1[r][-1]=0
for c in range(14): D1[0][c]=0; D1[23][c]=0
for r in (0,23): D1[r][0]=D1[r][-1]=4
# Demo 2
rl2=[0,6,12,18,24]; cl2=[1,5,9,13,17,21,25]
mat2=[[0,0,0,0,9,9,9],[0,0,0,0,9,9,9],[0,0,8,1,1,8,8],[8,7,7,1,1,9,9],[8,7,7,8,8,9,9]]
marks2={(r,c):v for ri,r in enumerate(rl2) for ci,c in enumerate(cl2) if (v:=mat2[ri][ci]) != 8}
D2=patterned(25,27,rl2,cl2,2,8,marks2)
# Demo 3
rl3=list(range(1,29,3)); cl3=list(range(3,24,4))
# matrices at special rows 13,16,19,22,25,28 and columns 3,7,11,15

marks3={(r,c):mat3[i][j] for i,r in enumerate([13,16,19,22,25,28]) for j,c in enumerate([3,7,11,15]) if mat3[i][j]!=2}
D3=patterned(29,26,rl3,cl3,1,2,marks3)
for name,g in [('D1',D1),('D2',D2),('D3',D3)]: print(name,solver.transform(g))
